why: Review found deleted branches could be recreated before the closed-PR guard; inactive recipe was stale

decision: Bound resolved per-attempt timeout at 2s fleet-wide
why: #325 fixed the strict-DoT stall class (plain DNS on headless hosts, DoT on alpha, stale retention) but kept the default 5s per-attempt timeout: alpha DoT retains up to ~15s worst-case stalls for never-cached names, over the glance 10s budget and the fleet-health 6s budget. 2s per attempt with three diverse upstreams bounds the worst case near 6s
evidence: resolvectl statistics on epsilon (42 upstream timeouts in 3.5d); glance RSS context-deadline errors; failing check set always DNS-dependent
result: modules/aspects/networking.nix; evaluation all hosts + alpha build

decision: Deliver ready notices via the run summary and Discord; retire per-watcher tracker issues
why: Per-watcher tracker issues cluttered the issue page and notify() failed closed without one; workaround-holding watchers self-disarm as post-lock instead
evidence: upstream-publish.py; upstream-watch.yml; watchers.json; nodejs-security cleanup recipe
result: notify() pings Discord once per status change with delivery state on automation/upstream-notify-state; nodejs-security is a post-lock cleanup watcher for the #341 overlay family

decision: Verify configs by real evaluation in CI, bound local builds, and retire the authelia ARM gate
why: The streaming incident showed unrestricted local native builds on alpha starve realtime workloads (35k sink underruns, load 73); stubbed CI evals masked eval breakage in the stubbed subtrees while real toplevel evals measured 20-35s per host; the authelia pnpm workaround was retired in #237 so its native ARM gate only re-validated dead code
result: Real-drvPath CI evals; alpha nix limits max-jobs=2 cores=3; runners pinned ubuntu-26.04; arm-authelia gate and dispatch plumbing removed; neovim builds push to repparw.cachix.org

decision: Keep Whisper Small as dictation default; hold Parakeet Ultra at test-aspect readiness
why: Whisper Small (Vulkan) transcribes 2.7x faster (0.32s vs 0.89s inference on 2.7-12s clips) at 0.059 WER vs Ultra 0.038 on FLEURS en/es read speech; Ultra costs ~2.8 GB resident (fp16) vs 0.17 GB; es-AR conversational/code-switching/short-utterance coverage still needs real alpha recordings before a default flip
evidence: vox-bench results in docs/research/parakeet-ultra-evaluation.md; 8 FLEURS clips x 3 runs x both arms on voxtype 1.1.1
result: Ultra validated working (fp16 on ORT CPU, canonical-name rename in linkFarm); test aspect staged for live dictation trial, activation blocked by pre-existing nodejs-slim output-check breakage
